notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – Maze Update
notes.content:
We’ve made several improvements to the maze section of the game to enhance clarity and improve the overall player experience. Thanks for your feedback!

💡 Hint System Update

Enhanced in-game hints with more relevant guidance.

⚙️ Accessibility & Ease of Use

Simplified maze navigation flow to reduce player confusion.

notes.title: 🎮 Demo Update – Performance Improvements! 🚀
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just pushed an update to the SQUAWKY demo, and we’ve made a few important changes based on your feedback:

🛠 Performance Fixes
We’ve resolved several performance-related issues that were affecting gameplay stability and framerate. The game should now run smoother across a wider range of hardware.

⚙️ Updated Default Graphics Settings
To help the game run better on lower-end PCs, we’ve adjusted the default graphical settings to be more performance-friendly. You can still tweak everything manually in the settings menu to match your preferences.

Thank you all for playing and sharing your feedback, it helps a ton! Keep it coming, and stay tuned for more updates.

— Spark Labs Gaming Team
